    public static function addFunctionPrefix(string $functionString): string
    {
        $prefixedFormula = $functionString;

                                $spillReplacement = 'ANCHORARRAY(' . $cellReference . ')';
                            } else {
                                Coordinate::coordinateFromString($localReference);
                                $spillReplacement = 'ANCHORARRAY(' . $cellReference . ')';
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (\Throwable $exception) {
                        $spillReplacement = 'ANCHORARRAY(' . $cellReference . ')';
                    }

                    try {
                        if ($cellReference !== '') {
                            if (Coordinate::coordinateIsRange($cellReference)) {
                                $spillReplacement = 'ANCHORARRAY(' . $cellReference . ')';
                            } else {
                                Coordinate::coordinateFromString($cellReference);
                                $spillReplacement = 'ANCHORARRAY(' . $cellReference . ')';
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (\Throwable $exception) {
                        $spillReplacement = 'ANCHORARRAY(' . $cellReference . ')';
                    }

                $spillConverted .= $spillReplacement;
                $scanIndex = $spillOffset + strlen($spillText);

                $scanIndex = $formulaLength;
            }
        }
        $prefixedFormula = $spillConverted;

        $parsedTokenCount = 0;
        try {
            $formulaParser = new FormulaParser('=' . $prefixedFormula);
            $parsedTokenCount = $formulaParser->getTokenCount();
            if ($parsedTokenCount > 0) {
                $parsedFormulaText = $formulaParser->getFormula();

        $identifiedFunctions = [];
        $functionScanOffset = 0;

        $xlfnOutput = '';
        $xlfnOffset = 0;
        $xlfnLength = strlen($prefixedFormula);
        while ($xlfnOffset < $xlfnLength) {
            if (preg_match(self::XLFNREGEXP, $prefixedFormula, $xlfnMatch, PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE, $xlfnOffset) === 1) {
                $matchPosition = (int) $xlfnMatch[0][1];
                $matchText = $xlfnMatch[0][0];
                $capturedBody = $xlfnMatch[1][0];
                if ($matchPosition > $xlfnOffset) {
                    $xlfnOutput .= substr($prefixedFormula, $xlfnOffset, $matchPosition - $xlfnOffset);
                }
                $functionCore = StringHelper::strToLower((string) preg_replace('/^(?:_xlws\.)?/i', '', $capturedBody));
                $parserRecognized = false;

                }
                $xlfnOffset = $matchPosition + strlen($matchText);
            } else {
                $xlfnOutput .= substr($prefixedFormula, $xlfnOffset);
                $xlfnOffset = $xlfnLength;
            }
        }
        $prefixedFormula = $xlfnOutput;

        $xlwsOutput = '';
        $xlwsOffset = 0;
        $xlwsLength = strlen($prefixedFormula);
        while ($xlwsOffset < $xlwsLength) {
            if (preg_match(self::XLWSREGEXP, $prefixedFormula, $xlwsMatch, PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE, $xlwsOffset) === 1) {

                $matchText = $xlwsMatch[0][0];
                $capturedName = $xlwsMatch[1][0];

                } else {

                }

            } else {
                $xlwsOutput .= substr($prefixedFormula, $xlwsOffset);

    /**
     * Prefix function name in string with _xlfn. where required.
     * Leading character, expected to be equals sign, is stripped.
     */
    public static function addFunctionPrefixStripEquals(string $functionString): string

        return self::addFunctionPrefix(substr($functionString, 1));
